implemented_dependency_graph_modes.definition: Shortest registered dependency path between two QMO/graph roots; existing edge orientation is preserved.
All registered dependency edges whose endpoints lie in the selected/expanded member set.
Depth-bounded dependency neighborhood around one or more roots under an explicit direction policy.

higher_order_graph_objects.definition: Recursive/merged graph from QMO, Dependency Graph, and/or Dependency Landscape inputs.
Ordered recursion of crawl -> graph -> landscape -> resolved QMO steps, with append-only History and terminal closure/fork state.

guard: Specialized semantic views filter registered structure; they do not invent edges.
